description:
House of Khalsa creates heritage-inspired watches and extrait de parfum perfumes designed with meaning, craftsmanship, and gifting in mind. Our products are premium, story-driven, and built to be worn and remembered—perfect for customers who value identity, culture, and quality.

• What makes us different:

✅ Premium + giftable products that convert well through storytelling
✅ Distinct heritage-inspired designs (high share value on social)
✅ High AOV catalog (great earnings per sale for affiliates)
✅ Strong bundle appeal (ideal for upselling and bigger commissions)

• How affiliates can earn:

Earn commissions on qualifying purchases made through your unique affiliate link or personal discount code:

Commission LevelOrder Total (AUD)Commission
Level 1A$0+18%
Level 2A$450+22%

🍪 Cookie window: 60 days (link clicks qualify within the cookie window; code usage also tracks your referrals).

• How to promote us:

Best-performing promo styles include:

  • 🎥 UGC videos: unboxings, “meaning behind the design,” gifting moments, date-night/event prep

  • 📸 IG posts + Stories: lifestyle shots, product close-ups, “why I chose this” story

  • 📝 Blogs & gift guides: “best gifts,” “premium heritage accessories,” fragrance reviews

  • 🔗 Always share your affiliate link and/or discount code in captions, bio links, and video descriptions.

• Other information:

  • ✅ You’ll get access to a partner dashboard with tracking + assets (links, coupons, creatives).

  • 💬 Support: email customercare@houseofkhalsa.com (Subject: Affiliate Program)

  • 📌 Please disclose your affiliate relationship (e.g., “I may earn a commission”).

  • 🚫 Not allowed: misleading claims, self-referrals, spam, coupon-site posting, or bidding on our brand name in paid ads without written approval.
payout_period: Commissions lock after a 45-day validation (returns/refunds/chargebacks). Approved commissions are paid monthly on the 15th (next business day) for orders through the prior month-end, once you reach A$50. Refunded/cancelled orders don’t qualify.

term_and_condition:
1. About These Terms

These Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions (“Terms”) govern participation in the House of Khalsa Affiliate Program (“Program”). By applying to or participating in the Program, you (“Affiliate”, “you”) agree to these Terms.

Company: House of Khalsa (“we”, “us”, “our”)
Website: houseofkhalsa.com
Contact: customercare@houseofkhalsa.com (Subject: “Affiliate Program”)

2. Program Summary (At a Glance) 🕰️🌸

ItemDetails
Commission rule18% on qualifying orders; 22% on orders A$450+
TrackingUnique affiliate link and/or discount code
Cookie window60 days (link-based)
Validation45-day validation/lock period
PayoutsMonthly on the 15th (or next business day), for prior month’s approved commissions
Minimum payoutA$50
Key restrictionsNo brand bidding, no coupon/deal sites, no spam, no self-referrals

3. Eligibility & Enrollment

  1. Who can join: Content creators, publishers, bloggers, community leaders, and others who can promote our products in a brand-aligned way.

  2. Application: We may accept or reject applications at our discretion.

  3. Account accuracy: You must provide accurate information and keep it updated.

4. Tracking & Attribution (Links + Codes)

  1. Affiliate link tracking: Referrals are tracked via cookies when a customer clicks your affiliate link. The cookie lasts 60 days.

  2. Discount code tracking: Purchases made using your unique discount code may be attributed to you even if the customer did not click your link (subject to platform tracking rules).

  3. Attribution priority: If a customer uses a different affiliate’s code, attribution may follow the code used at checkout.

  4. No interference: You must not use tools or tactics that overwrite/steal attribution (e.g., forced redirects, cookie stuffing).

5. Commission Structure (Order-Value Based)

Commissions are calculated per qualifying order based on the order value at checkout:

  • Level 1: Order value from A$0 → 18% commission

  • Level 2: Order value from A$450 → 22% commission

Qualifying orders must be legitimate, non-fraudulent, and not cancelled/refunded/charged back.

Commission is typically calculated on the product subtotal (excluding shipping, taxes, and tips where applicable, depending on your settings).

6. Validation, Returns, Refunds & Chargebacks

  1. Validation/lock period: Commissions are subject to a 45-day validation period to account for returns, refunds, chargebacks, and fraud checks.

  2. Reversals: If an order is refunded, cancelled, returned, or charged back, any related commission may be voided or reversed.

  3. Order review: We may withhold approval on suspicious orders.

7. Payouts 💸

  1. Payout schedule: Approved commissions are paid monthly on the 15th (or the next business day) for orders placed through the prior month-end once the validation period is satisfied.

  2. Minimum payout threshold: A$50 (or your configured threshold).

  3. Payment methods: Via available methods enabled in your affiliate portal (e.g., PayPal, bank transfer, store credit).

  4. Taxes: You are responsible for any taxes, reporting, or declarations related to your earnings.

8. Promotion Rules (Allowed vs Prohibited)

✅ Allowed promotional methods

  • Content marketing: blogs, editorial, SEO content, product reviews

  • Content creators/influencers: TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, UGC

  • Communities/forums and social groups (non-spammy, value-first)

  • Email marketing to opt-in lists

  • Social messenger apps to warm audiences (no cold spam)

🚫 Prohibited promotional methods

  • Comparison shopping sites and cashback/loyalty/incentivized traffic

  • Browser extensions/software, toolbars, coupon scraping

  • Pop-up / pop-under / tab-under traffic

  • Push notifications

  • Direct linking / direct traffic arbitrage

  • Paid search ads and brand bidding (see below)

  • Posting codes on coupon/deal sites without written permission

  • Any misleading, deceptive, or spam-based tactics

9. Paid Ads & Brand Bidding Policy

  1. No brand bidding: You may not bid on “House of Khalsa” or variations/misspellings in search ads.

  2. No impersonation: You may not create ads/pages that appear to be operated by House of Khalsa.

  3. Paid social restrictions: Paid social may require written approval. If approved, you must comply with our brand and ad guidelines.

10. Disclosure & Compliance

You must clearly disclose your affiliate relationship wherever required (e.g., “I may earn a commission from qualifying purchases”). You agree to follow applicable advertising laws and platform rules (including FTC-style disclosure principles where relevant).

11. Brand Assets & Intellectual Property

  1. Limited license: We grant a limited, revocable, non-exclusive license to use provided brand assets solely to promote House of Khalsa under these Terms.

  2. No modifications that mislead: Do not alter logos or messaging in a way that confuses customers.

  3. Revocation: We may request removal or changes to any use of our assets at any time.

12. Prohibited Conduct (Zero Tolerance)

  • Self-referrals (purchasing through your own link/code)

  • Fraudulent orders, fabricated leads, or incentive manipulation

  • Cookie stuffing, forced clicks, redirect loops

  • Spam (including unsolicited DMs, comment spam, or mass messaging)

13. Termination

We may suspend or terminate your participation at any time if we believe you violated these Terms, engaged in fraud, harmed the brand, or used prohibited traffic sources. Upon termination, you must stop promoting and remove our brand assets.

14. Disclaimers & Limitation of Liability

We provide the Program “as is” without warranties. To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect or consequential damages, lost profits, or tracking interruptions.

15. Indemnity

You agree to indemnify and hold House of Khalsa harmless from claims arising from your promotional activities, content, or violations of these Terms.

16. Governing Law

These Terms are governed by the laws of Victoria, Australia, and the parties submit to the courts of that jurisdiction.

17. Updates to Terms

We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued participation after updates constitutes acceptance.
